system_thesis_interpretation: The intended paper object is a finite synthetic construct for action-conditioned text memory: an ordinary action produces public evidence; a target-blind prospective/revision compiler consumes only lawful evidence; and a later sterile actor attempts legal world action after the installed diagnostic memory has been unmounted. That can be a useful benchmark/method paper even when B3 is a complete null, native backends dominate, or renderer sensitivity limits scope, because those outcomes delimit the construct and release a complete adversarially controlled finite surface. It is not a paper about general online learning, learned parameters, whole-organism necessity, or SOTA. Eight independent twin-pair roots and 7,264 nested rows are an intentionally noninferential descriptive terminus; they add credibility through completeness, failure inclusion, and falsifiability, not sampling power. The title is appropriately scoped as a finite protocol and stress test, provided the protocol never promotes its stress-test signs into efficacy language. However, the requested human decision cannot yet advance this paper object: the bound scope authorizes only architecture deliberation through human_required and expressly forbids the A2 implementation and CPU fixtures needed to build and validate the construct. Ratifying that exact scope would certify a deliberation already completed, leave the construct NOT_RUN, and require another SHA-bound intake before construction can begin.
graph_delta_interpretation: V2 materially improves the causal graph by separating a content-blind randomizer from a semantic installer, then erasing treatment, assignment, capability, cache, timing, and reset descendants before common-prior-plus-public-branch-delta compilation. It also makes A2 immutable before B0 and confines POST_B3_DEV_DISPOSITION to one post-seal reporting/planning event. The resulting P1 object can diagnose a directional action-to-public-evidence-to-target-blind-reconsolidation-to-later-action path if the paired-RNG, unmount, cut/sham, same-event, common-history, and audit gates actually pass. It cannot establish formal mediation or that DREAM caused learning. The active `PAS_T03_RANDOMIZED_UNMOUNTED_MEDIATION` identifier is risky terminology: presentation-facing labels must call it a randomized unmounted causal-cascade diagnostic and explicitly retain the no-formal-mediation qualifier. The terminal state graph is otherwise sound: only valid complete favorable and valid complete null text paths may request a fresh deliberation, while NOT_RUN, REJECT, early stop, incomplete-after-dispatch, and invalid organs are ineligible.
loop_delta_interpretation: The protocol now constrains the relevant loop rather than merely asserting a memory story. Fixed opportunity slots rather than realized content control cadence; target-blind assignment and treatment removal block a direct installed-memory-to-answer route; branch action/outcome is the only permitted post-unmount branch difference; and later goals, query state, and cursors are sterile and ephemeral. The proposed closed ontology is stronger than a matrix because it requires exactly-once definitions and finite instances, transitive most-restrictive taint, lifecycle/shape/destruction fields, and symmetric-difference failure. These are prospective requirements only: no current ontology, capability isolation, mutation suite, renderer audit, or B3 execution is evidence. If implemented exactly, the loop tests a finite action-conditioned memory pathway rather than a fixed replay or treatment-label artifact; it remains vulnerable only to residual base-model/task shortcuts that the held-out red team must empirically bound rather than claim to exhaustively rule out.
claim_delta_interpretation: V2 correctly sets the current scientific-claim set to empty; C1--C4 remain DEFERRED_NEW_PREREGISTRATION and Stage D is NOT_REQUESTED_STAGE_D. FAVORABLE_DESCRIPTIVE is an observed predeclared pattern, and PROCEDURALLY_COMPLETE_NULL is an observed finite boundary, not a population result, a negative population effect, a model-owned-memory advantage, a continual-learning result, or LoRA evidence. The exact result templates, complete-release requirement, raw-root/failure display, realized PAYLOAD_AGE/L_native axis, and separation of terminal action from path-use are scientifically valuable anti-laundering measures. Two repairs are nevertheless blocking for the language/result lock. First, the post-B3 AS-EXT designation must not choose the comparator used in a FAVORABLE_DESCRIPTIVE sign: a pre-frozen but result-dependent selector can change the favorable/null class of identical B3 raw data. Freeze a non-performance-selected primary comparator before B0, or require the comparison against every AS-EXT candidate (conservatively the strongest); restrict POST_B3_DEV_DISPOSITION to display/planning only. Second, replace the active phrase `retention-noninferiority component` with a named finite retention-tolerance/descriptive sign and lint `noninferiority`/`NI` from claim-facing labels. A noninferiority term conflicts with the explicit ban on inferential claims when no valid inferential procedure is permitted.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The visibility design meaningfully distinguishes public opportunity/evidence, SELF semantics and lifecycle, schedule, cursor/order, exploration capability/assignment/memory, branch event/delta, evaluation state, truth/target, errors, resources, prior results, A2 configuration, and post-B3 disposition. It also correctly treats hashes, errors, omissions, handles, timing, cache state, and receipts as tainted descendants rather than harmless metadata. T13/T14/T15/T17/T19 make the proposal substantially more capable of detecting renderer, routing, policy-prior, wrong-life, and semantic shortcut failures. Their prospective nature is decisive: until the exact closed registry, role isolation, fixture coverage, held-out commitments, mutation output, independent reviews, and explicit human scientific-call authority exist, the only admissible evidence status is NOT_RUN.
acceptance_test_interpretation: All 21 tests are prospective and therefore NOT_RUN, not currently passed. PAS_T01 specifies total world/opportunity allocation, unpadded payload-age/OLD safeguards, and fixed cadence needed to keep lifetime/AS-CTX effects from being padding artifacts. PAS_T02 makes terminal action representation-neutral and rules out independent-atom/nonadaptive substitutes while allowing legitimate recurrent/native alternatives. PAS_T03 gives a credible randomized unmounted causal-cascade diagnostic only, subject to the terminology repair; it is not mediation evidence. PAS_T04 binds target-blind model-owned compilation and same-event/common-history mechanical controls. PAS_T05 specifies faithful native baselines and complete reporting but is blocked until AS-EXT post-B3 designation cannot affect the favorable/null classifier. PAS_T06 correctly fixes eight roots, 908 rows/root, all failures, no inference, no reuse, and deferred Stage C, but is blocked until the inherited retention-NI sign is renamed as a noninferential finite tolerance. PAS_T07 requires actual descendant mutation/noninterference and clean reset proof. PAS_T08 keeps the costed B3 surface finite and locks Stage C/D, but the present scope authorizes none of the construction or fixtures it presupposes. PAS_T09 correctly treats A4 as row/scoring/sterility integrity, never efficacy credit. PAS_T10 correctly treats NOT_REQUESTED_STAGE_D as a passing non-artifact disposition, so absent LoRA work is not missing B3 evidence. PAS_T11 requires independent raw-root reproduction and canonical claim projections. PAS_T12 requires the complete A2 cognition freeze, goldens, review, and exact human call authority. PAS_T13 upgrades the matrix to closed exact-set ontology/instance conformance. PAS_T14 tests content-blind randomization against semantic and operational side channels. PAS_T15 proves chronology/nonreachability but shares the T05 blocking repair because post-B3 selection currently reaches terminal classification through the designated AS-EXT comparator. PAS_T16 should reject the AS-EXT classifier route and inferential retention-NI wording, and should require the `PAS_T03` presentation qualifier. PAS_T17 supplies an independently held-out renderer/semantic, passive-signature, and prompt-scaffold red team, correctly stopping on hard shortcuts and narrowing only under a precommitted renderer boundary. PAS_T18 properly separates common-envelope capability from complete-vector partial Pareto dominance, without resource-normalized superiority; it requires all coordinates and no starvation. PAS_T19 is the essential attribution repair: matched misbinding/wrong-life memory, equally provisioned native raw-evidence policy, single-return audit, and separate terminal/path/model-owned-path values prevent policy success or provenance alone from receiving model-owned-memory credit. PAS_T20 is blocked until the two result-language/classifier repairs above are made; after that its exclusive taxonomy can publish useful favorable, null, native-dominance, renderer-bound, stop, NOT_RUN, or REJECT descriptions without claim laundering. PAS_T21 exhaustively preserves eligible favorable and null paths while excluding all absent, rejected, early, incomplete, and invalid paths from automatic LoRA work. None of these requirements supplies current scientific evidence or authorization, and the exact present scope does not authorize the A2 implementation/fixtures that could turn them into evidence.
assumptions: A later separately authorized A2 package can make the finite field universe, planned instances, capability isolation, serializer behavior, and mutation suite executable without weakening the proposal's classes or lifecycle rules.

The independent held-out shortcut audit can test materially different renderer, label, morphology, prompt-scaffold, passive-signature, and no-memory routes before B-stage outcomes; it cannot prove the absence of every pretrained semantic prior.

The misbinding/wrong-life control preserves information amount, interface, and shape while breaking authentic life binding, and the raw-evidence policy receives native iterative retrieval rather than a SELF-specific wrapper.
All native backends can be faithfully provisioned on the complete assigned surface, with full offline and online resource coordinates measured and no method-specific starvation.
The two blocking language/selection repairs are made before A2/B0 and subjected to T05, T06, T15, T16, and T20 lint/review.
Eight roots, target rows, and all nested diagnostics will remain labeled as DEV/falsification/planning observations and will not be reused as confirmation data.

ambiguities.question: What exact non-performance rule currently determines the designated AS-EXT series, and can that designation change a favorable-descriptive classification?
ambiguities.impact: The documents permit a one-time post-B3 designation while the fifth-sign taxonomy compares SELF to the designated series. Without the stated blocking repair, raw data can receive a result-dependent favorable/null label.

ambiguities.question: Is the registered `.05 retention-noninferiority component` only a deterministic finite tolerance sign, or does it retain an inferential calculation?
ambiguities.impact: If inferential, it contradicts the explicit no-interval/no-population-inference terminus; if deterministic, its active name still misstates what the eight-root surface establishes.

ambiguities.question: How will the independent red team decide that an unmodeled pretrained semantic prior is a hard shortcut versus residual renderer sensitivity without accessing B-stage outcomes?
ambiguities.impact: A transparent pre-result rule is needed to avoid turning a difficult semantic failure into a convenient RENDERER_BOUNDARY after results are known.

ambiguities.question: Which registered B1/B2 gate items carry the wrong-life and raw-evidence attribution controls, and how will their diagnostic scope be reported separately from all B3 terminal-action rows?
ambiguities.impact: The design correctly withholds model-owned-path credit when controls fail, but readers must not mistake terminal action on untested B3 rows for completed attribution evidence.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: POST_B3_DEV_DISPOSITION is described as reporting/planning-only, but the FAVORABLE_DESCRIPTIVE sign compares SELF with an AS-EXT series designated only after all B3 cells seal.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: A frozen selection algorithm may still select on the observed B3 surface. If that selected identity controls the .05 AS-EXT comparison, it changes terminal taxonomy and paper rhetoric even though it does not mutate cognition. This is outcome-conditioned comparator selection, not merely harmless reporting disposition.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Before B0, either designate one AS-EXT comparator by an immutable non-performance property for every taxonomy calculation, or require the favorable comparison against every executed AS-EXT candidate using the strongest relevant candidate. Remove POST_B3_DEV_DISPOSITION from all favorable-sign/classifier inputs; leave it only a non-claim report-view/planning field, then add a T05/T15/T16/T20 mutation proving taxonomy invariance to disposition.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The active favorable-sign definition calls for a `.05 retention-noninferiority component` while the contract forbids a terminal noninferiority statement and forbids inferential analysis of eight DEV roots.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Whether or not the underlying operation is a simple finite threshold, the word noninferiority imports an inferential conclusion that the protocol expressly refuses to estimate. It weakens the promised exact language lock and makes a descriptive sign easy to rhetorically launder.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Rename and define it before A2 as a `finite retention-tolerance descriptive sign` with an explicit deterministic root-vector rule; remove `NI` and `noninferiority` from active claim-facing graph/test/figure/result vocabulary; and require T06/T16/T20 lint to reject their return unless a future separately ratified inferential design is in scope.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The retained active test identifier `PAS_T03_RANDOMIZED_UNMOUNTED_MEDIATION` can be read as a mediation claim despite the body correctly rejecting formal mediation.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The graph and paper language otherwise use a directional offline-compilation causal-cascade diagnostic. A bare mediation label is needlessly stronger than the permitted descriptive mechanism reading.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Retain the immutable registry ID if predecessor compatibility requires it, but bind a mandatory display name, graph subtitle, and lint rule: `randomized unmounted causal-cascade diagnostic — not formal mediation`; prohibit the standalone word `mediation` in claims, captions, and result headings.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The scope proposal asks a human to ratify only non-scientific deliberation through human_required while explicitly forbidding implementation and CPU fixtures, so its ratification does not authorize the A2 work required to construct or validate the proposed benchmark.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The exact configured role calls are the deliberation now producing interpretations, critique, and recommendation. A ratification whose authorized scope is constrained to those same calls cannot create the field registry, renderer, capabilities, fixtures, red-team, or gates; all remain NOT_RUN. A further exact-SHA proposal and intake would then be required before the paper can make any construct-level progress, making the proposed human decision materially redundant for throughput and delaying feasibility evidence.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Do not present ratification of this scope as advancing implementation or paper feasibility. Either intentionally close it as a deliberation-only governance receipt, or submit a new exact-SHA scope for human decision that explicitly and narrowly authorizes A2 construct implementation and CPU fixture certification after the blocking protocol repairs, while retaining separate review and later scientific/GPU authority.

open_questions: Whether the two blocking pre-B0 repairs—taxonomy-invariant AS-EXT comparison and noninferential retention-tolerance wording—are accepted and bound into a new exact proposal before any scientific authority is considered.

Whether the human intends a deliberation-only receipt, or instead wants a new scope that can authorize the otherwise-forbidden A2 construct implementation and CPU fixture work; the current ratification cannot do both.

Whether a human ratifies only the narrow finite synthetic construct/protocol and future A2 implementation/review scope, with no inference, Stage C, Stage D, training, LoRA, publication, or successor authorization implied.

Whether an eventual complete descriptive null, native-baseline dominance, or renderer boundary would be released as the scoped benchmark paper object rather than relabeled as general continual-learning evidence.
